display.purpose: Landing-page thesis and major product statements.

label.purpose: Source IDs, revisions, paths, code, and status.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse non-essential animation when the user requests reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid hsl(172 58% 32%); border-radius: 2px; background: hsl(172 58% 32%); color: hsl(42 25% 98%); font: 600 14px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(172 58% 32%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Domain Card
components.description: Groups one semantic C or C++ documentation object.
components.css: .ds-domain-card { border: 1px solid hsl(216 19% 88%); border-radius: 4px; background: hsl(40 20% 96%); color: hsl(220 19% 15%); font: 400 15px/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-domain-card code { display: block; padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(216 19% 88%); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-domain-card p { margin: 0; padding: 16px; } .ds-domain-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(172 58% 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Revision Block
components.description: Marks content constrained to specific language revisions.
components.css: .ds-revision { padding: 14px 16px; border-left: 2px solid hsl(172 58% 32%); background: hsl(172 30% 95%); color: hsl(220 19% 15%); font: 400 15px/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-revision span { color: hsl(215 12% 43%); font: 600 12px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; }

components.name: Review Evidence Row
components.description: Separates source coverage from semantic review state.
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 48px 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(216 19% 88%); color: hsl(220 19% 15%); font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-row code { color: hsl(215 12% 43%); font: 400 12px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-status { color: hsl(172 58% 32%); }

narrative.overview: A calm, precise workspace for reading technical material and auditing automated migrations. Information density, thin structural rules, direct typography, and source evidence take precedence over decoration.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal communicates navigation, focus, or verified state; it is not general decoration.

rules.name: The Code Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Code and machine identifiers always use mono typography and preserve meaningful whitespace.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border or tonal layer can explain hierarchy, do not add shadow.

dos: Do preserve a readable prose column while allowing code and tables to scroll horizontally.
Do use thin rules and stable grids to expose semantic relationships.
Do label machine-derived evidence with mono text and explicit status wording.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't use gradients, ornamental blobs, oversized rounded cards, or decorative shadows.
Don't use teal on large background areas; its rarity preserves meaning.
Don't hide unsupported migration patterns behind generic success states.
Don't compress comparison panes so far that code or source text becomes unreadable.
